expanded_candidate_rows.name: COMPLETENESS
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: KA-R52 requires every accepted governing MUST-level obligation to be traceable to realization or governed deferral with no untracked third state; SP-1 CQ-REAL-01 only queries the active tracked set and does not close acceptance-event omission.

thin_v02.mechanism: THIN tracks admitted REQUIRE clauses well once created, but Research 442 has no deterministic acceptance-event completeness declaration proving every accepted governing MUST was either represented or explicitly non-realizing.
thin_v02.deficiency: Add closed completeness accounting at governing acceptance.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: V0.5 AcceptanceDeclarationSet records the accepted normative delta, resulting units where required, standing bindings, or CREATES_NO_REALIZATION_UNITS.

expanded_candidate_rows.name: DONE_DEFINITION
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: KA-R52 requires evidence and qualification status, and SP-3 consumes evidence_required/qualification_required/activation_required without defining which governing authority sets those requirements.

thin_v02.mechanism: THIN can reference evidence/qualification policy and SP-3 can evaluate bounded facts, but Research 442 makes acceptance_or_claim_ref optional and does not require a governing-side completion criterion for consequential REQUIRE satisfaction.
thin_v02.deficiency: A realizer declaration must not define its own completion standard.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: V0.5 grouping references common evidence and qualification closure and natural owners provide EVIDENCES/QUALIFIES, but V0.5 does not clearly make an explicit governing completion criterion a mandatory accepted field for every consequential unit.
rich_v05_accepted.deficiency: The rich model also needs an explicit authority rule for completion criteria.

expanded_candidate_rows.name: PARTIAL_COMPLETION
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: Research 447 explicitly permits PARTIAL edges but states that PARTIAL does not satisfy by itself unless a bounded composition rule exists; the probe used only FULL satisfying edges, so this remains an admitted unresolved machine question.

thin_v02.mechanism: THIN has PARTIAL as a declared coverage mode but no frozen composition semantics; multiple PARTIAL declarations cannot currently produce deterministic completion.
thin_v02.deficiency: Needs governed composition or criterion-based completion.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: V0.5 defines when accepted items share a realization/evidence/qualification boundary, but it does not specify how several artifacts partially realize one unit or when their combined evidence closes it.
rich_v05_accepted.deficiency: Grouping does not solve multi-artifact partial completion.

expanded_candidate_rows.name: REQUIREMENT_LINEAGE
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: Research 327 explicitly requires governed successor relations for split/merge/replacement and DRP-07 requires live normative lineage across contract partition/migration; the original SP-1 inventory does not test N:M requirement succession.

thin_v02.mechanism: THIN LIFECYCLE supports old/new references and prospective change, but Research 442 does not specify N:M SPLIT/MERGE/CARRY_FORWARD mapping or explicit unmapped-loss accounting.
thin_v02.deficiency: Needs richer governed relation semantics in the identity/lifecycle layer.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: V0.5 explicitly states that split, merge, rescope and replacement create governed successor relations, which is the right semantic concept, but the exact N:M representation and loss/unmapped accounting remain to be qualified under DRP-07.
rich_v05_accepted.deficiency: Concept is present; executable relation contract is not yet qualified.

expanded_candidate_rows.name: OWNER_ACCOUNTING
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: DRP-06 requires bounded generated current orientation and KA-R52 requires visible realization accountability; no SP-1 CQ requires one governed versioned obligation-status derivation for that orientation.

thin_v02.mechanism: Research 442 permits generated orientation views and exact source predicates but deliberately selects no global status definition, so separate consumers could name equivalent states differently.
thin_v02.deficiency: Needs one governed non-authoritative orientation derivation if DRP-06 shows the vocabulary is useful.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: V0.5 already defines a deterministic derived realization sequence over validated REALIZES/EVIDENCES/QUALIFIES/ACTIVATES/DEFERS facts; DRP-06 can project that source-owned state into a bounded non-authoritative view.
rich_v05_accepted.deficiency: Exact final vocabulary still depends on DRP-06 needs.

expanded_candidate_rows.name: CROSS_DECISION_CONFLICT
expanded_candidate_rows.admission_reason: KA-I06 requires unresolved governing-authority conflict to be surfaced rather than guessed away. Existing CQ-AO-05 and CQ-BR-03 cover authority resolution and stale plan conflict but do not explicitly test contradictory active machine consequences across accepted decisions.

thin_v02.mechanism: Typed REQUIRE/PROHIBIT/AUTHORIZE/GATE scopes make machine consequences comparable and Research 442 already requires accepted-component inconsistency and projection conflict to fail visible; exact semantic incompatibility rules remain domain/authority-resolver policy.

rich_v05_accepted.mechanism: Accepted V0.5 delta identities and kinds can participate in the same authority/conflict resolver, with source/declaration conflicts yielding REVIEW_REQUIRED; domain-specific incompatibility still needs the same resolver policy.

thin: Typed cross-domain action/consequence semantics for REQUIRE/PROHIBIT/GATE/AUTHORIZE/SEQUENCE avoid relying on the coarser V0.5 normative-kind taxonomy for deterministic ActionContract-style control.
Typed clause slots bind exact actions, consequences, scopes and predicate/decision references without future prose reinterpretation.
rich: AcceptanceDeclarationSet provides closed acceptance-time completeness accounting, including an explicit no-realization result.
V0.5 explicitly preserves governed split/merge/replacement successor semantics for requirement lineage.
V0.5 supplies one deterministic derived realization-status sequence over natural-owner source facts.

shared_gaps: Neither frozen arm fully specifies who must author/own a governing completion criterion sufficient to prevent realizer self-certification for every consequential requirement.
Neither frozen arm defines and qualifies general multi-artifact PARTIAL coverage composition.
selective_hybrid_amendments_required: closed acceptance-time completeness accounting for accepted governing realization obligations
governing-side or governed-domain completion criteria for consequential satisfaction
one governed versioned non-authoritative owner-orientation/status derivation if justified by DRP-06
